slug: 2017-01-01 AU - Report on the Status of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics in Africa
note: A continental report of the October 2016 APAI-CRVS monitoring round, giving counts of countries, not country answers; Zambia appears only in the annex's composite score bands (digitization 35-49 per cent, planning, coordination and monitoring 80-100 per cent, infrastructure and resources 65-79 per cent, legal framework 65-79 per cent, vital statistics under 35 per cent, overall 50-64 per cent), which state no value of any aspect and name no system.
